payout_quote: The deposit and refund value may not be less than 5¢. / For wine and spirits containers of greater than 50 milliliters, the refund value may not be less than 15¢.
steps: Buy eligible beverages in Maine (5¢ deposit on most containers; 15¢ on wine/spirits containers over 50ml)
Return them to a retailer or redemption center
Receive the 5¢ (or 15¢ for wine/spirits) refund per container
catches: This returns YOUR OWN deposit money paid at purchase — it is recovering your own money, not new income.
Only containers bought in-state with the correct deposit label are redeemable; out-of-state containers are ineligible and redeeming them is fraud.
Maine covers nearly all beverages except dairy and unprocessed cider — unusually broad, but only in-state purchases qualify.
biggest_catch: Returns your own deposit — you paid it at purchase. This is deposit recovery, not income.
eligibility: Anyone who purchased eligible beverage containers in Maine.

c1.evidence: Maine Revised Statutes Title 38 §3103, official mainelegislature.org publication (current through Oct 1, 2025).

c2.evidence: 38 MRS §3103: refund value may not be less than 5¢; wine/spirits containers over 50ml not less than 15¢.

c3.evidence: No fee; deposit already paid at purchase.

s1.note: Maine-purchased eligible containers (all beverages except dairy/unprocessed cider).

s6.note: Steps are concrete: buy, save, return, get refund.

notes: Maine has the broadest bottle bill scope in the US (covers juice, water, nearly everything).
payout_value_note: Official: 5¢ minimum most containers; 15¢ minimum wine/spirits containers >50ml (38 MRS §3103).
numeric_basis: payout from 38 MRS §3103 (5¢/15¢ per container); time: collecting empties + return trip est. 20–60 min active.
